messages:
tara: proposing a phased activation for the routing flag `route_by_cost_v2`. goal: roll safely with automatic backoff if error/latency/quota regressions show up. sketch below, feedback pls.

leo: nods. can you outline the telemetry gates? what exact metrics will trigger backoff/rollback?

tara: good Q. plan is three gates — latency_p99, error_rate, quota_consumption_rate. each gate has a window and a threshold. if any gate exceeds threshold for 2 consecutive windows we step back 1 phase. ultimate failure triggers full rollback.

maria: how would this appear in console? i want a visible per-flag rollout view + the gate statuses and last triggered reason. also a timeline of phases.

sam: +1 to console visibility. also need an alerting integration so on a step-back we page oncall if it's not a benign backoff (e.g., sustained p99 > 500ms).

leo: will the rollout be percent-based or user-segment-based? percent rolls can hide hot-path regressions.

tara: percent-based with optional routing-key segmentation. default policy: 1% -> 5% -> 20% -> 100% with min-dwell per phase = 10m. segmentation keys allow targeting only internal traffic or a subset of customers.

maria: example rollout config?

tara:
```yaml
flag: route_by_cost_v2
strategy:
  type: phased_percent
  phases:
    - pct: 1
      dwell: 600s
    - pct: 5
      dwell: 900s
    - pct: 20
      dwell: 1800s
    - pct: 100
      dwell: 0s
gates:
  - name: latency_p99
    window: 120s
    threshold_ms: 450
    breach_consecutive_windows: 2
  - name: error_rate
    window: 120s
    threshold_pct: 0.5
    breach_consecutive_windows: 2
  - name: quota_consumption_rate
    window: 300s
    threshold_pct_change: 40
    breach_consecutive_windows: 2
actions:
  on_gate_breach: step_back
  on_final_failure: rollback
  notifications: [pagerduty, console, slack]
```

leo: looks sensible. couple of nitpicks: 1) threshold_pct for error_rate should be absolute or relative? prefer absolute (0.5% avg). 2) quota threshold as % delta is OK but need baseline window definition.

tara: agree — error_rate is absolute. baseline for quota is last 24h avg by default, but flag can set custom baseline window.

sam: operational runbook pls. what do folks do if auto-step-back keeps happening? will we allow manual override?

tara: manual override exists (force-phase) but requires two approvers in console for >20% phases. also we expose a dry-run mode for safe verification (no traffic switched, only telemetry simulated).

maria: UI ask: show a compact badge on flag list (green/yellow/red) with tooltip summarizing gate state and last action. clicking opens timeline + metrics panels.

leo: small API ask: add an endpoint to query flag rollout state + last N gate events. something like `GET /flags/:id/rollout` returning current_phase, metrics_snapshot, events[].

tara: will add. include `recommended_action` in the response from the rollout controller so console can surface whether rollback will happen automatically.

deploy-bot: dry-run scheduled by tara for 1749999999. job id: dryrun-2024-11-23-02. output will be in /runs/dryrun-2024-11-23-02/logs.

sam: thanks. once dry-run completes can we run a 1% canary limited to internal accounts for 30m? want to validate quota and warm caches.

tara: yes — plan after dry-run: internal 1% for 30m, monitor gates. if clean, progress to 5% with 15m dwell.

leo: one more: ensure KV-cache warmup isn't misinterpreted as quota spike. we should have a startup grace window that ignores first 2 windows of quota delta for a host that hasn't seen traffic.

tara: good catch — adding host-grace for quota gate. default: ignore first 2 windows per host-id.

maria: can we also tag rollout events with correlation_id so support can link user reports to a specific phase?

tara: yes — rollout controller will emit correlation_id on each action/event.

sam: sounds good. operational checklist for rollout (to add to docs): 1) dry-run 2) internal 1% 3) 5% 4) 20% 5) 100% with console + PD hooks and manual override process described.

leo: ack. i'll follow up with the API schema PR for `/flags/:id/rollout` and event model.

maria: i'll mock the console badges and timeline widgets and post screenshots in #eng-design later.

tara: thanks all — i'll update the draft config and open RFC. tagging @leo @maria @sam for reviews. :thumbsup:
